identity.title: Multi-window bulk-flow bridge has rank 3 (identifies homogeneous tilt); a single window has rank 1

theorem.fixture: window operator 10W with integer rows r1=(10,1,0), r2=(2,8,1), r3=(0,2,7), r4=(6,3,2).
claims: det(G) = 394584 != 0 -> rank(10W) = 3: the 3-component homogeneous tilt is identified
a single window (row r1) gives an outer-product Gram of rank 1: it identifies only one mode
hence a single bulk-flow amplitude cannot point-identify the 3-D homogeneous tilt; a multi-window field bridge can

notes: Wolfram/SymPy/Sage compute exact matrix rank + Gram det over QQ; Lean and Rocq (independent kernels) verify the integer determinant 394584 != 0 and the single-window outer-product rank 1. No majority vote; all five axes PASS.
